question: If (a)/(b) = 0.25, then the value of ( {frac{{2a - b}}{{2a + b}}} ) + (2)/(9) is:
solution:
Given:

a/b = 0.25, then the value of ( {frac{{2a - b}}{{2a + b}}} ) + (2)/(9).

Concept used:

Divide by b bot numerator and denominator.

Calculation:

 ( {frac{{2a - b}}{{2a + b}}} ) + (2)/(9)

⇒ ( {frac{{2a/b - 1}}{{2a/b + 1}}} ) + (2)/(9)

⇒ ( {frac{{2times 0.25 - 1}}{{2times 0.25 + 1}}} ) + (2)/(9)

⇒ {frac{{-0.5}}{{1.5}}} + (2)/(9)

⇒ {frac{{-1}}{{3}}} + (2)/(9)

⇒ {frac{{-3+2}}{{9}}} 

⇒ (-1)/(9)

∴ The correct answer is (-1)/(9)
